investigation_notes: Reliability incident investigation of a production environment. Evidence consists of Elasticsearch aggregation results over application and proxy logs, Kubernetes, cloud-provider and host system events, Prometheus Alertmanager alerts, change-management / CI-CD audit records and metric anomaly detection. No root cause, impact or trigger is stated; these must be established from the supplied artifacts. Environment context: Organization: Nimant Telecom (mobile operator); Platform: on-premises data center DC-South, server range 10.97.0.0/16; Kubernetes cluster nimant-prod (kubeadm); Database: mysql server roaming-db-01 reachable from the application network only through firewall policy DB-TIER on fw-03; Change management: production changes carry CR- identifiers.
